body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Berlin, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 2.0 km. It starts at People Museum - BODY WORLDS Berlin, Panoramastraße 1A, 10178 Berlin, Germany. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to BODY WORLDS Berlin. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Your ticket to BODY WORLDS is included in this self-guided audio walking tour through central Berlin. Please note that an audio tour inside BODY WORLDS is not provided.
> After your visit to BODY WORLDS, unpause thistour and continue your walk past the lawns and river views of Monbijoupark, the elegant Bode-Museum, the German Historical Museum, Berlin Cathedral, and the Humboldt Forum. The walk then leads into the cobbled Nikolaiviertel, on to the Red City Hall, across lively Alexanderplatz to the World Time Clock, and ends beneath the soaring Berlin TV Tower.
>
> Along the way, you will see green domes, red brick, broad socialist-era squares, riverside paths, and some of Berlin’s most important landmarks. Memorable moments include standing by the Spree opposite Museum Island, tracing Berlin’s medieval beginnings in Nikolaiviertel, and looking up at the TV Tower’s silver sphere above the city crowds.
